examples.text: tena hi, bhaṇe, yo bāhiresu janapadesu āyo sañjāyati tato upaḍḍhaṃ antepure pavesetha, upaḍḍhaṃ tatth'eva dānaṃ detha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānan'ti.
alaṃ, bhaṇe jīvaka, tuyham'eva hotu. amhākaññ'eva antepure nivesanaṃ māpehī'ti.

seyyathā'pi saha bhaṇḍena gahitacoraṃ, vadhetha nan'ti rañño āṇāya rājapurisā bandhitvā catukke catukke pahārasatāni dentā āghātanaṃ nenti.

āyām'ānanda, yena bhaṇḍagāmo ten'upasaṅkamissāmā'ti.

49249.commentary: (THa) tass'attho, paṭipattisaddhammaṃ chaḍḍetvā āmisakiñjakkhahetu aññam'aññehi bhaṇḍare kalahaṃ karontī'ti.

examples.text: pariccajitvā saddhammaṃ, aññam'aññehi bhaṇḍare, diṭṭhigatāni anventā, idaṃ seyyo'ti maññare.
taṃ kissa hetu? antamaso bhaṇḍadhovanam'pi bhavissatī'ti.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivād'āpannānaṃ viharataṃ bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikkantaṃ.
alaṃ, bhikkhave, mā bhaṇḍanaṃ mā kalahaṃ mā viggahaṃ mā vivādan'ti

49253.commentary: (NIDD1a) bhaṇḍanakārakā'ti tattha tattha gantvā bhaṇḍanaṃ karontā. (KVt) bhaṇḍanakārakehī'ti kalahakārakehi.

examples.text: tassa parikkhāraṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, bhaṇḍanakārakaṃ kalahakārakaṃ vivādakārakaṃ bhassakārakaṃ saṅghe adhikaraṇakārakaṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, tassa parikkhāraṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā

49255.commentary: (VINa) bhaṇḍanajātānan'ti sañjātabhaṇḍanānaṃ. bhaṇḍanan'ti kalahassa pubbabhāgo, iminā ca iminā ca idaṃ kataṃ, evaṃ vutte evaṃ vakkhāmā'ti-ādikaṃ sakasakapakkhe sammantanaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivād'āpannānaṃ upassutiṃ tiṭṭheyya yaṃ ime bhaṇissanti, taṃ sossāmī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivād'āpannānaṃ viharataṃ bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikkantaṃ.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭiseneti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu akkosantaṃ paccakkosati, rosantaṃ paṭirosati, bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭiseneti.
opammaṃ karohī'ti. yathā, mahārāja, rañño bhaṇḍ'āgāriko bhaṇḍ'āgāraṃ pavisitvā nīla-pīta-lohit'odāta-mañjiṭṭhāni rājabhogāni rūpāni passitvā sañjānāti. evaṃ kho, mahārāja, sañjānanalakkhaṇā saññā'ti.

49262.commentary: (SNa) itthī'ti avissajjanīyabhaṇḍattā, itthī bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ, varabhaṇḍan'ti āha. atha vā sabbe'pi bodhisattā ca cakkavattino ca mātukucchiyaṃ'y'eva nibbattantī'ti, itthī bhaṇḍānam'uttaman'ti āha.

examples.text: kiṃsu issariyaṃ loke, kiṃsu bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ. kiṃsu satthamalaṃ loke, kiṃsu lokasmim'abbudaṃ.
vaso issariyaṃ loke, itthī bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ, kodho satthamalaṃ loke, corā lokasmim'abbudā.

49264.commentary: (VINa) rajakabhaṇḍikan'ti rajakānaṃ bhaṇḍikaṃ. rajakā sāyanhasamaye nagaraṃ pavisantā bahūni vatthāni ek'ekaṃ bhaṇḍikaṃ bandhanti. tato ekaṃ bhaṇḍikaṃ tesaṃ pamādena apassantānaṃ avaharitvā thenetvā'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rajak'attharaṇaṃ gantvā rajakabhaṇḍikaṃ avaharitvā ārāmaṃ haritvā bhājesuṃ.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, addasaṃ bhaṇḍuñ'ca nāma bhikkhuṃ ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ ābhiñjikañ'ca nāma bhikkhuṃ anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ aññam'aññaṃ sutena accāvadante, ehi, bhikkhu, ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī'ti.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto purisaṃ bhaṇḍuṃ pabbajitaṃ kāsāyavasanaṃ. disvā sārathiṃ āmantesi, ayaṃ pana, samma sārathi, puriso kiṃkato?
atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, saṅghaṃ apaloketuṃ bhaṇḍukammāyā'ti.

49276.meaning2: brought up, maintained, reared, born, supported

49279.commentary: (THa) bhatako yathā'ti yathā bhatako parassa kammaṃ karonto kammasiddhiṃ anabhinandanto'pi kammaṃ karonto'va divasakkhayaṃ udikkhati, evaṃ aham'pi jīvitaṃ anabhinandanto'pi attabhāvassa yāpanena maraṇaṃ anabhinandanto'pi pariyosānakālaṃ paṭikaṅkhāmī'ti.

examples.text: n'ābhinandāmi maraṇaṃ, n'ābhinandāmi jīvitaṃ, kālañ'ca paṭikaṅkhāmi, nibbisaṃ bhatako yathā.
paṇḍito'ti samaññāto, sāriputto akodhano, app'iccho sorato danto, kālaṃ kaṅkhati bhatako sudanto'ti.

49280.meaning1: supporting those who raised one; taking care of those who nurtured one

examples.text: ovādakārī bhataposī, kulavaṃsaṃ ahāpayaṃ, saddho sīlena sampanno, putto hoti pasaṃsiyo'ti.
so kir'eko duggatamanusso hutvā bhatiṃ pariyesanto anāthapiṇḍikassa santike bhatikammaṃ labhitvā taṃ nissāya jīvikaṃ kappesi
ath'ekasmiṃ uposathadivase sampatte anāthapiṇḍiko vihārato āgantvā pucchi, tassa bhatikassa ajj'uposathadivasabhāvo kenaci kathito'ti? na kathito, sāmī'ti.
yāya mātu bhato poso, imaṃ lokaṃ avekkhati, tam'pi pāṇadadiṃ santiṃ, hanti kuddho puthujjano.
paccati munino bhattaṃ, thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule, piṇḍikāya carissāmi, atthi jaṅghābalaṃ mamā'ti.
so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya, parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
so me nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā'ti

ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, aho vata mam'eva bhikkhū purakkhatvā purakkhatvā gāmaṃ bhattāya paviseyyuṃ, na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū purakkhatvā purakkhatvā gāmaṃ bhattāya paviseyyun'ti.

49287.meaning2: devoted to; attached to; believing in

examples.text: yo brāhmaṇaṃ samaṇaṃ vā, bhattakāle upaṭṭhite, roseti vācā na ca deti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
ehi, tāta raṭṭhapāla, gharaṃ gamissāmā'ti. alaṃ, gahapati, kataṃ me ajja bhattakiccaṃ. tena hi, tāta raṭṭhapāla, adhivāsehi svātanāya bhattan'ti.
so āsanāni paṭisāmeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ paṭisāmeti, avakkārapātiṃ paṭisāmeti, bhatt'aggaṃ sammajjati

ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, aho vata aham'eva labheyyaṃ bhatt'agge agg'āsanaṃ agg'odakaṃ aggapiṇḍaṃ, na añño bhikkhu labheyya bhatt'agge agg'āsanaṃ agg'odakaṃ aggapiṇḍan'ti.

aññataro bhikkhu piṇḍapātaṃ ādāya yena so bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca, bhuñjāhi, āvuso'ti. alaṃ, āvuso, atthi me bhattapaccāsā'ti. tassa bhikkhuno piṇḍapāto ussūre āharīyittha.

49298.meaning1: series of meals; succession of meals
49298.commentary: (VMVt) tatiye pāḷiyaṃ bhattapaṭipāṭi aṭṭhitā'ti kulapaṭipāṭiyā dātabbā bhattapaṭipāṭi aṭṭhitā na ṭhitā, abbocchinnā nirantarappavattā'ti attho.
